notes.title: 0.28.7 | Bugfixes, balance & hats
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779523/2cfe19c661ded83ceaaca1ba31500205ffe81ead.png[/img]

Another day, another round of magical bug hunting and balance tuning!

This patch brings a number of critical fixes, improvements to pathfinding, visual upgrades, and quality-of-life enhancements — all while laying the groundwork for some surprises.

Thank you for all your feedback — here’s what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779523/bebcf1cf81b1c681ffd1192460dbc7c2e4b51a70.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Mana production no longer breaks when unlocking a technology during a drought.
[*] Trial Room no longer crashes if a student with zero cycles remaining is sent in.
[*] Mana Windmill production is now correctly removed when the building is destroyed.
[*] Arrows turning red and doors staying closed due to environmental factors should behave properly again.
[*] Type II Droughts are now back in action. Hydrate wisely.
[*] The Etherfang Decoy was nearly impossible to fully charge — it's now balanced and ready for use.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of professor cost-per-cycle in the inspection menu.
[*] Professor cost-per-cycle no longer shows a negative sign but is displayed in red instead. Conversely, student cycle costs now show in green during admission.
[*] Walls of the Golemancy Floor are no longer mysteriously missing.
[*] Resolved issues with room placement above Exam Halls — you can't build directly over them anymore.
[*] Recruiting Rank II (or higher) students could completely break the game — that’s now fixed.

[*] Professor's room access: The pathfinding in the professor's room on the upper floor has been improved for better accessibility.

[*] Councillor’s will & mana buildings: When mana-storing buildings are destroyed or deactivated, the Councillor’s Will updates properly.
[*] Selection highlight fixed: Deselecting characters now properly removes the highlight, cleaning up your UI interactions.
[*] Caretaker office renamed: Based on community feedback, the "Caretaker Office" is now the "Caretaker Cottage." Thank you for the suggestion!
[*] Quest bug resolved: The quest requiring active buildings on a specific floor has been fixed.
[*] Council quest implementation: The unconfigured quest for council members, "have one room of type X," is now active.
[*] Graduate NPC pathing: Graduates now use alternate paths instead of heading directly to the mana wellspring.
[/list]

[*] Additional sound effects: You’ll hear sound effects when toggling roofs, closing windows, or naming your school.

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779523/eba54a08ee72ab60dfe1fd05b078d60d802f9f29.jpg[/img]

[h2]System improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Council menu shortcut: Clicking "Regain the council’s trust at all cost" now directly opens the council menu.
[*] Mana storage reactivation: Mana storage buildings can now be reactivated even if mana is depleted, as long as the storage isn’t empty.
[*] Council member unlocks patched: Obtaining the first, second, and third council members has been patched for smoother progression.
[*] Outline system overhaul: We’ve completely redesigned the outline system using a new framework for better visuals.
[*] Council wills unlock: Wills for council members now unlock at each new tier.
[*] Floating students: Students now float again after being pranked, adding a fun touch to your academy.
[*] Pranked professors’ animation: The pranked animation for professors has been revamped.
[*] Trees are now hidden where you want to place your building.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Groportor animation: Groportor is now animated when you start the game, bringing even more life to the opening moments.
[*] Professor room texture fixed: The missing texture in the professor room, caused by shader issues, has been fixed.

That’s all for this update! We’re excited to see your entries in the building contest, so get creative and aim for those Steam gift cards! 

Keep the feedback coming, and see you in the academy!
